Your goals, tasks, and focus sessions are saved in this browser. They aren't synced between devices. Clearing browser data will remove them.

WELCOME TO ASCEND

A day with direction.

  1. Give your day a direction. Add a goal, then schedule small tasks that move you towards it.
  2. Find your next step. Your current scheduled task appears in the focus card. Press Start when you're ready.
  3. Make room for changes. Select a task to edit it, or switch to an independent focus session.
  4. See your progress. Complete tasks to move your goal forward. Focus hours track the time you actually spend.
